description: This is a Request for Information (RFI) only. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation. Responses to this RFI will not be considered as offers, nor will they result in a contract or order. FEMA is seeking information from industry to better understand available solutions and capabilities. Respondents are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in responding to this RFI. Participation is voluntary and responses will be treated as informational only.
